required_context: Authoritative designations distinguish two truck routes from every intervening non-truck street.
Establish designation, network connectivity, ego path and map support; do not infer a between-routes journey from the control alone.

Jurisdiction, city street status, actual control and automation information, unresolved chapter scope and definition applicability.
Preserve unresolved meanings of 'through routes', 'essential use' and 'required enroute', chapter-level actor and vehicle scope, definition applicability and actual control or automation information.
Retain the complete traveled path and street identities rather than inferring between-route use from a designation.

Whole-passage path and street identities, trip-purpose records, relevant premises and access activity.
